name: shift-planner
description: Shift Planner — workforce scheduling and resource planning system

scripts.build: npm run build -w @shift-planner/core && npm run build -w @shift-planner/api && npm run build -w @shift-planner/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @shift-planner/api" "npm run dev -w @shift-planner/web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @shift-planner/core && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
